notes: v974: PERF — throttle live-sync full re-pull. startLiveSync was running a full CloudSync.init() (re-pull of all ~10 tables) every 30s AND on every focus/visibilitychange → ~85 Supabase calls/~90s on a 2,300-record account (services 42x, requests 16x), causing slow load + transient search misses. Now throttled to one full re-pull / 2 min; realtime subscriptions still deliver live updates. Fixes 'takes forever to load' + 'search can't find a visible record'.
